comparison.reference: pinned PyTorch CPU KModelForONNX with disable_complex=True

audio_contract.amplitude_domain: normalized float amplitude; valid samples are strictly inside (-1.0, 1.0)

comparison.alignment: compare sample index after the exact sample-count check; do not resample, time-align, truncate, or pad
comparison.exact_reference_note: The committed WAVs use exact TorchSTFT. The export-path PyTorch reference is the parity baseline because the ONNX graph intentionally uses the recorded CustomSTFT approximation; exact-reference drift remains a diagnostic, not a reason to weaken this conversion gate.

policy.aggregation_rule: Every measurement passes for every reference vector. There is no average-over-vectors waiver. The stated across_vectors aggregation is the reported worst case.

sample_count.description: Candidate waveform length must equal the reference waveform length exactly.

waveform_error.description: Pointwise error over aligned normalized float32 samples.
waveform_error.pass_condition: For every vector, both waveform error measurements are at or below their thresholds.

spectral_similarity.description: Similarity of non-negative short-time magnitude spectra.
spectral_similarity.pass_condition: For every vector, the flattened STFT magnitude cosine similarity meets the floor.

aggregation.per_vector: cosine over the flattened magnitude matrices

silence.description: Reject an output that is silent or effectively silent as a whole.
silence.pass_condition: For every vector, RMS is above its floor and no more than the allowed fraction is below the silence level.

clipping.pass_condition: For every vector, no sample is clipped and the absolute peak stays strictly below full scale.

invalid_values.description: Reject non-finite numeric output before any other numeric metric is considered.
invalid_values.pass_condition: For every vector, the waveform contains zero NaN or infinite samples and the output has the declared dtype, shape, sample rate, channel count, and non-empty contract.

aggregation.per_vector: 1 if dtype, shape, sample rate, channel count, or non-empty contract is invalid; otherwise 0
